acceptance_criteria: Add app-level domain models for inspection identifiers, measurements, bbox observations, phase decisions, subsystem health, and WebSocket inspection snapshots.
Add JSON schema contracts for the WebSocket/HMI inspection snapshot payload under contracts/flange_qc_v2/**.
WebSocket payload validation rejects bounding boxes outside [0, 1] and unknown decision states.
Unknown or missing production capability remains represented as BLOCKED or bootstrap/degraded state; no SOP PASS/NG production rule is implemented.
Existing health endpoint and product CI keep passing.
rollback_note: Revert the FQV2-002 PR to remove the domain model module, WebSocket schema contract, and related tests while leaving the FQV2-001 bootstrap app skeleton intact.
